question: For molecules containing chlorine atoms with single bonds, calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules. Then, among these chlorine-containing single-bond molecules, identify which ones also contain sulfur atoms with double bonds and list their bond IDs. Finally, determine the most common bond type across all bonds in these specific molecules.

WITH cl_single_bond_mols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN atom AS a ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
  WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'cl' AND b.XCL_006 = '-'
),
sulfur_double_bond_mols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN atom AS a ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
  WHERE a.XCL_003 = 's' AND b.XCL_006 = '='
),
specific_mols AS (
  SELECT csm.molecule_id
  FROM cl_single_bond_mols AS csm
  WHERE csm.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM sulfur_double_bond_mols)
),
carcinogenic_pct AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(m.XCL_010) AS pct
  FROM cl_single_bond_mols AS csm
  JOIN molecule AS m ON m.XCL_010 = csm.molecule_id
),
sulfur_double_bond_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_004 AS bond_id
  FROM specific_mols AS sm
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.XCL_005 = sm.molecule_id
  JOIN atom AS a ON a.XCL_002 = sm.molecule_id
  WHERE a.XCL_003 = 's' AND b.XCL_006 = '='
),
most_common_bond_type AS (
  SELECT b.XCL_006 AS bond_type
  FROM specific_mols AS sm
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.XCL_005 = sm.molecule_id
  GROUP BY b.XCL_006
  ORDER BY COUNT(b.XCL_004) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  cp.pct AS carcinogenic_percentage,
  sdbi.bond_id AS bond_id,
  mcbt.bond_type AS most_common_bond_type
FROM carcinogenic_pct AS cp
CROSS JOIN sulfur_double_bond_ids AS sdbi
CROSS JOIN most_common_bond_type AS mcbt
